hero.title: Grid logic that stays out of your way.
hero.subtitle: GridKit separates grid logic from rendering. Sorting, filtering, and paging live in framework-agnostic TypeScript; React just renders the result — so you're never fighting a component to get the behavior your data needs.

features.title: Built to be read, not just used
features.subtitle: Three packages, one clean split between logic and rendering.

items.title: Framework-agnostic core
items.description: Column inference, ordering, and resizing live in plain TypeScript — testable without a DOM, and ready for adapters beyond React.

items.title: Semantic React components
items.description: DataGridComponent renders semantic class names and carries no styles of its own, so your theme decides how it looks.

items.title: A theme you can swap
items.description: @gridkitjs/theme-tailwind ships the grid's palette as OKLCH tokens with a built-in dark mode — or bring your own stylesheet.

core.name: @gridkitjs/core
core.description: Column inference, ordering, and resizing logic.

react.name: @gridkitjs/react
react.description: The DataGridComponent and its supporting hooks, built on core.

themeTailwind.name: @gridkitjs/theme-tailwind
themeTailwind.description: The grid's stylesheet — palette tokens, dark mode, grid styles.

cta.title: Start with the docs
cta.description: Every example on the docs site runs the real, published packages — nothing simplified for the demo.
